metric.name: standalone startup-to-title readiness
metric.definition: A reachable function is source-ready only when its recovery status is semantic or exact-overlay; the score is reported by both function count and retail byte weight. Standalone completion requires zero reachable retail blockers, zero unaudited indirect call sites, and every integration gate to pass.

milestone.description: Launch the executable and initialize title.anm/title_v.anm
milestone.scope_note: Direct game-owned call closure plus the explicit title callback root. System DLL imports are host dependencies, not retail-code blockers.

retail_free_link_target.evidence: build_all_pe32.sh links only reconstructed matching2 sources plus the standalone host layer; no retail bytes or hybrid image are consumed by the target

startup_to_title_smoke_test.evidence: the PE32 runner under Wine reports SMOKE_PASS: arena constructed, 4 primary + 22 secondary scheduler callbacks, 33 default device states, 640x480 viewport, title tasks registered, title.anm and title_v.anm resolved, 60 title frames, clean shutdown
